item.title: Authorities say they will release person of interest detained in Brown University shooting
item.description: Police in Rhode Island have a person of interest in custody over the shooting at Brown University campus that killed two people and wounded nine others, with the suspect last seen wearing a camouflage mask and the motive still unknown.

item.title: Watch: Philip Rivers tears up after his first game back with the Colts
item.description: Philip Rivers returned to the Colts and played his first NFL game since January 2021, sharing his motivation for returning and getting emotional, tearing up, in hopes of inspiring young people to not be afraid of what may or may not happen.

item.title: IMPD responds to over 100 crashes as winter storm brings Indy area to subzero temps
item.description: The dangerous cold has caused 111 vehicle crashes, 21 slide offs, and 15 disabled vehicles in Central Indiana, and the Indy Department of Public Works is working 12 hour shifts to clear the snow and ice from the roads.

item.title: IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza wins Heisman Trophy
item.description: IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza won the Heisman Trophy, becoming the first IU player to win the award, after leading the Hoosiers to a 13-0 record and their first Big Ten championship since 1967.

item.title: White House denies Trump threatened Indiana with funding cuts over redistricting
item.description: The White House has denied claims that President Trump threatened Indiana lawmakers with a loss of federal funds if they failed to approve new congressional maps, while the president and others have promised to support efforts to oust the 21 Senate Republicans who voted against redistricting.

item.title: Brutal cold tonight then midweek rain and thaw | Dec 14, 2025
item.description: Central Indiana will experience a slow, steady thaw through midweek, with temperatures rising into the 40s and 50s, followed by a cold snap and a return to the 30s for the weekend.

item.title: Colts fall to Seahawks in Philip Rivers’ return
item.description: The Colts lost to the Seahawks 18-16 in Philip Rivers' return to the Colts, dropping their record to 8-6 and marking their fourth straight loss.
